detail.longDescription: Flowcus 2.3.50 is out, with a fresh take on clearing your OmniFocus inbox 📥 ✨ Work through your inbox one item at a time, sending each to a next action, a new project, Do it now, Offload or Trash with a single key ✨ Do it now starts a two-minute timer, and Offload hands items to Obsidian, Bear or Apple Notes ✨ New: select several items and merge them into one with M ↩️ Every decision can be undone with ⌘Z https:// getflowcus.app/changelog/#2.3. 50 # OmniFocus # macOS # GTD # productivity # IndieApp
